summary_en: This Phase 1 study is testing PT0511, given alone or with cetuximab, in adults with advanced solid tumors that have a KRAS mutation or amplified wild-type KRAS. The listed conditions include colorectal cancer, pancreatic cancer, and non-small cell lung cancer. PT0511 is given by intravenous infusion until the disease gets worse or the participant cannot tolerate it, and how often and how long each dose is given is not stated. The main goal is to check safety and tolerability and to find the maximally tolerated dose and/or recommended Phase 2 dose.
summary_es: Este estudio de Fase 1 evalúa PT0511, administrado solo o con cetuximab, en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados que tienen una mutación de KRAS o amplificación de KRAS de tipo silvestre. Las enfermedades listadas incluyen cáncer colorrectal, cáncer de páncreas y cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas. PT0511 se administra por infusión intravenosa hasta que la enfermedad empeore o el participante no pueda tolerarlo, y la frecuencia y la duración de cada dosis no se indican. El objetivo principal es evaluar la seguridad y la tolerabilidad, y determinar la dosis máxima tolerada y/o la dosis recomendada para Fase 2.
who_for: Advanced or metastatic solid cancer confirmed by tissue or cell testing
KRAS mutation or amplified wild-type KRAS found by molecular testing
1 to 4 prior systemic therapies, or intolerant or ineligible for available therapies
Measurable disease by RECIST 1.1 and ECOG performance status 0 or 1
not_for: Active brain metastasis or carcinomatous meningitis, with some exceptions
Other cancer within the past 2 years, with some exceptions
Prior treatment with a KRAS/RAS degrader
Significant cardiovascular disease within 6 months of starting study therapy
Known hypersensitivity to any product given during dosing
